purpose: Preserve the source-defined sequence of local nondiscrimination preemption mechanisms across time so older, expired, and newer mechanisms are not treated as one contemporaneous event.

emit.statement: This source-defined preemption mechanism predates Project 2025 and remains represented as operative, preventing the family from being modeled as newly originating in the current federal period.
North Carolina is preserved as a historical family member whose source-described preemption expired in 2020 rather than as a current operative restriction.
The Texas source state introduces a 2023 broad preemption instrument later reported as being applied to an LGBTQ ordinance.
The Texas LGBTQ-ordinance application is temporally later than the general statute and remains contested in the source pass.
Iowa is represented as a newer 2026 state-local preemption mechanism reached through a different legislative vehicle from the older family members.
